[ASSISTANT_SAID] All suggested games have a similar level of complexity and strategy to Ticket to Ride.  
[EVENT] User expresses intrigue in Scythe and requests more information about it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scythe is a worker placement game designed by Jamey Stegmaier, set in an alternate history of the 1920s.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A typical game of Scythe takes around 90-120 minutes to play.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scythe is suitable for 1-5 players and plays well with all player counts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Gameplay includes worker placement, resource management, area control, and engine-building.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scythe includes high-quality components such as a large illustrated board, wooden player boards, and resource tokens.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scythe has several expansions: Invaders from Afar, Wind Gambit, and The Rise of Fenris.  
[EVENT] User expresses interest in the worker placement and resource management aspects of Scythe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Nordic Kingdom is a faction in Scythe that focuses on industrialization and trade.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Nordic Kingdom's unique ability allows for more efficient building of structures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Structure building involves costs, types of structures
